entities.summary: Nathaniel 'Nat' Philip Victor James Rothschild, 5th Baron Rothschild is a financier and hereditary peer of the United Kingdom, who is a member of the Rothschild banking family of England. Rothschild was born and grew up in England; he holds Canadian, Swiss and Montenegrin citizenship.
